units: Folded weights are CPU-clock nanoseconds, not counts.
limits: Both profiles use P64/W64; timing comparisons use unprofiled P32/W128.
Inclusive shares overlap. Do not add them to self shares.
Inline expansion and unresolved libc/reader frames limit attribution. Zero lost samples does not prove complete unwinding.
An increased percentage can result from a lower total CPU cost.
